SOLUTION PROVIDER
SOLUTION PROVIDER
Depending on the specific needs of each customer, PAMA identifies the machine tool, software packages and technological services that are best suited to propose the best solution possible for its customers.
The sales offer ranges from the configuration of the plant to the layout, from technology services for the analysis of the machining cycles to the definition of the equipment and tools.
A dedicated project manager accompanies each customer during the entire machine production process up until its acceptance.
